name: arena-comms-gateway
description: SMT Arena Comms Gateway — bridges broadcast comms ports (audio interface / AES67 RTP) to Arena Comms channels

scripts.build: tsc && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && electron-builder
scripts.electron: concurrently -k "vite --port 5176" "wait-on tcp:5176 && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5176 electron ."
